items.title: ‘Resetting BSKE no longer in Comelec’s hands’
items.description: The Commission on Elections  can no longer set a new date for the postponed barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections (BSKE) originally scheduled for Nov. 2, leaving Congress to determine when the polls will be held.

items.title: AMLC: No flood control money in Martin’s accounts
items.description: An investigator of the Anti-Money Laundering Council told the Sandiganbayan that the AMLC found no record of contractors, the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), or former lawmaker Zaldy Co sending money to suspended Leyte Rep. Martin Romualdez when he was House speaker.

items.title: DENR chief to ASEAN: Fast-track shift  to low carbon
items.description: As Southeast Asia continues to confront extreme weather, rising sea levels, severe typhoons and the El Niño, Environment Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna rallied ASEAN leaders to accelerate low-carbon transitions and secure direct climate finance during the opening of the ASEAN Pavilion at COP31.

items.title: Angelina Jolie: Invest in vulnerable communities
items.description: Hollywood actress and humanitarian advocate Angelina Jolie has called for greater investment in vulnerable communities, saying only genuine development can make them self-sufficient and less dependent on external assistance.

items.title: Marcos calls for patience amid ASEAN Summit disruptions
items.description: As monstrous traffic jams hit Metro Manila and flights were slated for cancellation or rescheduling, President Marcos yesterday called for cooperation and appealed for patience for the inconveniences caused by the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit.

items.title: 91% of Pinoys believe Asean hosting beneficial – SWS
items.description: Most Filipinos believe that the country’s hosting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations  leaders’ summit in Manila next week will be beneficial to the Philippines, a survey conducted by the Social Weather Stations from Sept. 21 to 27 showed.

items.title: DPWH warns of sanctions on ‘aircon engineers’
items.description: Sanctions will be imposed on “aircon engineers,” regional directors and district engineers who fail to conduct regular field inspections to ensure the safety of roads and bridges ahead of the Christmas travel rush, according to Public Works and Highways Secretary Giovanni Lopez.

items.title: Persistent China-linked dredging in Zambales hit
items.description: Opposition Rep. Leila de Lima again expressed exasperation over the continued large-scale dredging in Zambales, particularly the reported use of Chinese vessels, warning that the operations threaten the province’s coastal environment, fishing grounds, and the livelihoods of local communities.

items.title: Greta Thunberg rejects Pax Silica
items.description: Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg has joined calls to reject the US-led Pax Silica initiative.

items.title: AMLC gets CA asset freeze order covering  lawmaker, ex-official
items.description: The Anti-Money Laundering Council has secured a freeze order from the Court of Appeals covering bank accounts and other properties of a lawmaker and a former government official over alleged corruption involving government contracts.

items.title: World leaders set out clashing priorities as COP31 turns to negotiations
